name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.198
notes: Fluid event reminders now fire as real push notifications, even when CardiacLens is closed or the phone is locked.
Notification permission grant now subscribes the device to the CardiacLens fluid push service automatically.
The next upcoming fluid event's due time is kept in sync with the push service as events change.
Service worker now handles incoming push messages and notification taps.
